newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable, interest thin.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable, interest thin.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were generally stable in dull late trading on Wednesday as state logistics agency BULOG continued its intervention selling to put a lid on cooking oil prices ahead of Eid al-Fitr, traders said.
They said olein was quoted at 1,430-35 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, but offers were also heard at five rupiah below and above the range. Crude palm oil was offered at 1,250-55 rupiah/kg.
"The market was quiet, just like yesterday," one trader said. "Consumer demand should improve next week as Lebaran (Eid al-Fitr on May 9 and 10) draws closer."
"I am expecting consumer demand to increase next week as people start buying cooking oil for Lebaran," one trader said. "But so far, the market has been quiet."
Traders said state logistics agency BULOG was continuing with its market operations, selling olein at 1,435 rupiah.
They said the relatively high price of crude palm oil was keeping margins on olein slim to negative.
Data from Belawan Port showed that the MT Kamagowa will sail for Suez on Thursday with 2,870 tonnes of crude palm oil.
